text:
wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/msg10.txt: fix(streams): the read-loop fallback asked for 4096 where php's default chunk is 8192

The number was already right everywhere it had been written down. `stream_set_chunk_size($h, 100)`
answers `int(8192)` for a fresh stream, matching php, and `stream_get_line` carries an
`8192` constant of its own. Only the fallback inside `__rt_stream_chunk_size` said 4096 — and
that is the one a user wrapper can see, because it becomes the `$count` its `stream_read()`
receives.

MEASURED on `php -n` 8.5.6 against a wrapper that echoes what it was asked for:

    fgets($h)                    php  read(8192)
